notes.blurb: Field-stone walls laid dry, dark timber, low roofs pitched hard against weather. Everything looks quarried within sight of where it stands.
notes.construction: walls thick and battered at the base, openings small and deep, lintels of a single timber, no render
notes.ground: buildings step down a slope in whole storeys rather than sitting on a cut pad; retaining walls are the same stone as the walls above
notes.roofs: steep, (2,1) or (1,1), eaves low enough to touch, gables plain
notes.signature: an outshot lean-to along one long side, roofed shallower
